sections.section_title: OTG Dynamic update of the OTG_HFIR register
sections.text_helper: Section 73.10 "OTG Dynamic update of the OTG_HFIR register" in chapter 73 (USB on-the-go high-speed (OTG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 3775.
sections.section_content:
The USB core embeds a dynamic trimming capability of micro-SOF framing period in host
mode allowing to synchronize an external device with the micro-SOF frames.
When the OTG_HFIR register is changed within a current micro-SOF frame, the SOF period
correction is applied in the next frame as described in Figure987.
For a dynamic update, it is required to set RLDCTRL=1.
[Figure 987. Updating OTG_HFIR dynamically (RLDCTRL = 1)]
